requirement_matrix.requirement: A: full role-sensitive identity construction over assignment-first-appearance unique (cell,q), with evidence-invariant teachers and evidence/role/null-sensitive students
requirement_matrix.production_behavior: Builds 43,108 teacher, 215,540 correct, and 215,540 null identities in required order; total 474,188 and root 2f9a7529cc86ba4a39949b10818341f26a0ce6930c27159ad478c4d9fc30400f.
requirement_matrix.independently_reconstructed_expectation: Verifier standard-library canonical JSON/SHA-256 reconstruction over all authority rows produced the same root and 474,188 unique identities.
requirement_matrix.deliberate_detected_mutation: Role removal, evidence removal, null-source removal, and query collision were excluded by full-root and uniqueness comparison.

requirement_matrix.requirement: B: compute-only dedup while retaining all 44,496 assignments and five evidence mappings each
requirement_matrix.production_behavior: Uses assignment-first-appearance (cell,q), reports 43,108 unique keys, 1,388 dedups, and 222,480 assignment-evidence mappings.
requirement_matrix.independently_reconstructed_expectation: Verifier confirmed exact dedup membership against the frozen dedup CSV, no duplicate dedup members, and counts 44,496/43,108/1,388/222,480.
requirement_matrix.deliberate_detected_mutation: Dropping compute duplicates from inference would reduce the independently enumerated 222,480 assignment-evidence keyspace.

requirement_matrix.requirement: C: 222,480 deterministic float64 synthetic records with exact schema, endpoint reuse by (cell,q,evidence), and full downstream population topology
requirement_matrix.production_behavior: Creates one record per assignment-evidence row and passes accepted downstream aggregate population validation.
requirement_matrix.independently_reconstructed_expectation: Verifier recomputed every endpoint from SHA-256 without production expected-value helpers; all 222,480 records had exact schema and values, 215,540 compute endpoint keys, and 1,400 donor-operator groups.
requirement_matrix.deliberate_detected_mutation: Evidence, field-label, or compute-key perturbations change independently reconstructed values or reuse equality.

requirement_matrix.requirement: D: 1,400 lexicographic donor-operator shards with byte-exact interruption/resume and fail-closed AtomicShardStore binding
requirement_matrix.production_behavior: Artifact reports all 1,400 shards, 466 reused, byte/root equality, and rejection of membership, forward, dtype, shard-ID, order, duplicate-write, and payload-corruption attacks.
requirement_matrix.independently_reconstructed_expectation: Verifier independently counted 1,400 donor-operator pairs and exercised bounded interruption/resume with byte/root equality and all AtomicShardStore attacks rejected.
requirement_matrix.deliberate_detected_mutation: Stale membership/forward roots, reordered IDs, payload corruption, and duplicate commit all fail on bounded filesystem-safe shard IDs.

requirement_matrix.requirement: E: finalizer must itself require exact shard, forward-identity, and ordered effect-row populations under bound roots and implementation/root commit
requirement_matrix.production_behavior: validate_finalization only compares an actual six-field summary dictionary supplied by its caller with another six-field summary; it receives no shard IDs, forward IDs, effect-row IDs/order, or payloads from which to recompute counts/roots. Checked-in artifact binds e4414c6c74e4ebf8b89038771414a5959afb86d4, not implementation commit 82f0cf31dd4b897b7c84b5cb9f5c5ec00620a706.
requirement_matrix.independently_reconstructed_expectation: Shape-preserving missing+duplicate/replacement attacks must be detected even when scalar counts remain 1,400/474,188/222,480; roots and commit must be recomputed from actual finalization inputs.
requirement_matrix.deliberate_detected_mutation: A missing required shard plus replacement duplicate and a missing effect row plus duplicate both survive when the caller supplies unchanged summary fields; stale implementation provenance is accepted by independent_validation.

independent_reference_summary: Verifier code directly parsed frozen assignment/dedup/null authorities and reconstructed canonical identity hashes, ordered line root, SHA-derived synthetic values, record schema, compute-reuse mapping, and donor-operator geometry using only Python standard library arithmetic/hash logic. Production functions were called only as subjects under test, never as sources of expected values.
